assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key-area polygons are the repository's provisional rough geometry (official_boundary=false, boundary_precision=provisional_rough); not suitable for official redline or precise-area claims.
assumptions.impact: All area-sensitive figures and metrics must be recalculated as one set when official polygons are published; organizer data gaps do not block content scoring.

assumptions.statement: Low-speed robot right-of-way grading (shared/time-segregated/enclosed), robot routes, signal-control experiments and delivery handover points are conceptual suggestions pending a formal transport study and applicable robot/autonomous-mobility regulations.
assumptions.impact: No segment claims an approved right-of-way, road redline or operational permit; each pilot requires registration, human gate, failure-takeover plan and exit budget.

assumptions.statement: Building prototypes are public-program placeholders; no retain/renovate/demolish conclusion is made for any real building.
assumptions.impact: Formal deepening requires unique building IDs, age, structure, ownership and heritage-control data.

assumptions.statement: No scenario defaults to face recognition, emotion analysis or continuous location tracking; sensitive data requires re-authorization, impact assessment, retention and deletion mechanisms.
assumptions.impact: Privacy review must accompany each scenario before any pilot operates.

assumptions.statement: All pilots and scenarios follow the seven-step entry/exit protocol and register maintainer, response time, shutdown mode and exit cost.
assumptions.impact: Operation responsibility, human review and non-digital fallback must be confirmed by operators and community review before expansion.

assumptions.statement: Heritage control areas, road redlines and municipal capacity are unknown; drawings reserve replacement interfaces rather than inventing numbers.
assumptions.impact: Heritage constraints and statutory controls must be confirmed from official data before finalization.

assumptions.statement: Corridor main road, service loop and connectors are conceptual alignments; parking, loading, battery-swap and signal experiments need a formal transport study.
assumptions.impact: Road metrics are recomputed from this package's conceptual linework only.

assumptions.statement: Pilgrimage landmarks use reversible installations and wayfinding; identity never covers heritage fabric and implies no government endorsement.
assumptions.impact: Brand assets require rights clearance for any proposed use.

assumptions.statement: This package reuses the author's own previously merged package (submissions/Dytchem/xiaoyuehe-scenario-wing) as a validated base for site boundary, key-area polygons, topology-safe land-use partition, phasing partition and several shared metric families; all labels, roles, scenario content, narrative and evidence references are rewritten or rechecked for this theme, and all figures/PDFs/visuals are regenerated.
assumptions.impact: Originality review should treat the shared geometry/metrics base as the author's own prior work; spatial evidence layer reuse is disclosed for transparency.
